frame: datum frame from intake/alignment.json (frozen): primary = cap crown face -> XY at z=0, material +Z (toward the sleeve); origin = median of sleeve-envelope + cap-wall section centres; clock = lever centreline -> +X (area-weighted fourier_mass). theta CCW about +Z from +X. Sub-body axes (cap, collar, stem group) are measured positions IN this frame, never a re-levelled frame.

cap_cx.estimator: cap wall cone fit (axes.json): Z-parallel axis, faces z 2.8-12.9, lever sector -50..50 excluded

stem_axis_x0.estimator: stem-group axis line x(z)=x0+tan(tilt)cos(dir) z: LSQ line through 20 Z-parallel circle-fit centres (stem core 18.5-27.5, neck 30.3/30.9, sleeve 33.7-36.7, bore 36.3/36.8); resid rms 0.0418 max 0.0815

stem_axis_y0.estimator: same line, y intercept at z=0

stem_axis_tilt_deg.estimator: same line: atan(|(dx/dz, dy/dz)|) relative to datum Z (crown normal)
stem_axis_tilt_deg.frame: datum frame; tilt of the stem-group line from +Z

stem_axis_dir_deg.estimator: same line: atan2(dy/dz, dx/dz) = azimuth toward which the axis leans with +z
stem_axis_dir_deg.frame: datum frame, theta CCW about +Z from +X

crown_z.estimator: area-weighted mean z of crown faces (n_z<-0.995, r<10) - the datum primary plane; the crown is the datum primary (z=0 by construction), measured offset is inside the plane noise

cap_R_z0.estimator: cone r(z)=R0+k z extrapolated to the crown plane z=0 (same fit)

draft_deg.estimator: mean of the three moulded-wall draft reads [cap wall cone, lever +Y flank, lever -Y flank] (each: see measurements.json); one mould draft for cap, lever flanks, tip and blends
draft_deg.note: lever tip cone read 2.159 deg (lever_tip_draft_deg) - declared simplification

crown_round_R.estimator: mean of [cap crown-round circle fit (r,z), lever-tip crown-round circle fit (x,z)]; one fillet around the whole crown loop

step_z.estimator: mean of [cap step-face annulus z, lever underside z] (area-weighted +Z-facing faces, same moulded face)

step_edge_R.estimator: mean of [cap wall->step-face round fit, lever-tip underside edge round fit]; one fillet around the step-face outer loop

lever_flank_py_y0.estimator: lever +Y flank line at z=0 in plan, y = y0 + tan(plan_deg) x: y0 = y(x=18,z=0) - 18 tan(plan_deg), from lever +Y flank: line y(x=18)(z) through per-z plane-strip fits z 4-12.8 (lever.json), extrapolated to z=0

lever_flank_py_plan_deg.estimator: median over z of the per-z plan slope dy/dx (lever.json)
lever_flank_py_plan_deg.frame: datum frame, plan angle of the flank line from +X, CCW positive

lever_flank_my_y0.estimator: lever -Y flank line at z=0 in plan, y = y0 + tan(plan_deg) x: y0 = y(x=18,z=0) - 18 tan(plan_deg), from lever -Y flank: line y(x=18)(z) through per-z plane-strip fits z 4-12.8 (lever.json), extrapolated to z=0

lever_flank_my_plan_deg.estimator: median over z of the per-z plan slope dy/dx (lever.json)
lever_flank_my_plan_deg.frame: datum frame, plan angle of the flank line from +X, CCW positive

lever_tip_cx.estimator: median of per-z tip circle centres x

lever_blend_R_py_z0.estimator: concave lever-cap blend +Y: line R(z) through plan circle fits at z 4/7/10/12.5 (lever_blend_R_z0.per_fit), extrapolated to z=0 (slope -0.0483)

lever_blend_R_my_z0.estimator: concave lever-cap blend -Y: line R(z) through plan circle fits at z 4/7/10/12.5 (lever_blend_R_z0.per_fit), extrapolated to z=0 (slope -0.0888)

pocket_y_plus_at_step.estimator: pocket wall 'wall+Y (normal -Y)': line through per-z medians z 10-13.3 (pocket.json), evaluated at the lever step face z

pocket_y_minus_at_step.estimator: pocket wall 'wall-Y (normal +Y)': line through per-z medians z 10-13.3 (pocket.json), evaluated at the lever step face z

pocket_x_inner_at_step.estimator: pocket wall 'end_inner (normal +X)': line through per-z medians z 10-13.3 (pocket.json), evaluated at the lever step face z

pocket_end_cx.estimator: plan circle fit to the pocket outer-end wall faces x 19.9-22.6, z 11.8-13.4 (inward-facing)

pocket_draft_deg.estimator: mean of the pocket wall drafts [+Y wall, -Y wall, inner end] (lines through per-z wall medians z 10-13.3)

pocket_floor_z.estimator: floor seen sparsely: 64 +Z-facing faces in the pocket footprint, z p5 8.42 / p50 8.65 (pocket.json); value = mid of p5..p50
pocket_floor_z.note: floor only sparsely scanned (64 faces, z p5 8.42 / p50 8.65); depth ~5.15 below the step face

pocket_corner_R.estimator: mean of plan circle fits to the two inner-end corner wall faces (z 11.5-13.4)

mouth_ring_z.estimator: area-weighted z of +Z-facing ring faces r 11.45-11.95

collar_top_round_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) faces r 11.1-11.55, z 14.1-14.5, n_z>0.1 (concave round ring face -> collar)

collar_bot_z.estimator: area-weighted z of +Z-facing faces r 10.25-10.8, z 16.3-16.9

collar_bot_round_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) faces r 10.6-11.2, z 15.9-collar_bot_z, n_z>0.1 (convex round collar -> bottom face)

groove_out_rc.estimator: median over 30-deg sectors of circle fits (r,z) to the collar-face groove faces r 8.9-10.25 (collar frame) (per-sector reads 9.469, 9.523, 9.435, 8.540, 9.555, 9.573, 9.603, 9.565)

groove_out_bottom_z.estimator: same fits: centre_z - R (groove bottom) (per-sector reads 16.300, 16.257, 15.905, 15.770, 16.225, 16.352, 16.359, 16.369)

groove_in_rc.estimator: median of circle fits (r,z) to +Z-ish faces r 5.5-7.1, z 15.6-16.9, 50-deg sectors between ribs (stem frame) (per-sector reads 6.186, 6.046, 6.289, 6.306)

flange_z.estimator: mean of 45-deg sector medians of z of +Z-facing faces r 7.4-8.6 (stem flange ring face; the face is not level: see spread)

stem_base_z.estimator: lowest z (0.1 steps, z 16.6-19.5) where the between-rib median outward radius is within 0.03 of the stem-core cone line (stem frame)

stem_core_top_z.estimator: highest z (0.1 steps) where the between-rib radius is within 0.06 of the core line

neck_bot_z.estimator: lowest z (0.1 steps) where the between-rib radius is within 0.05 of neck_R

stem_core_R_base.estimator: stem-core cone line R(z) through station circle fits z 18.5-27.5 (R(18)=5.3083, R(28)=5.1594, measurements.json) evaluated at stem_base_z
stem_core_R_base.note: stem core is not perfectly round: station circle rms 0.072-0.087 (axis_stations.json)

stem_core_R_top.estimator: stem-core cone line R(z) through station circle fits z 18.5-27.5 (R(18)=5.3083, R(28)=5.1594, measurements.json) evaluated at stem_core_top_z
stem_core_R_top.note: stem core is not perfectly round: station circle rms 0.072-0.087 (axis_stations.json)

neck_R.estimator: mean of neck station circle fits z 30.3, 30.9

rib_count.estimator: pattern_count.py radius signal, rotational-order FFT dominant order 4 at z 19.5/22.5/25.5, residual local minimum at every station (CHK-COUNT pass)

rib_tip_r_flange.estimator: per rib: tip line through the p98 tip radii at z 18 and 27 (rib_tip_r_z18/_z27, measurements.json) evaluated at flange_z

rib_tip_r_top.estimator: per rib: same tip line evaluated at that rib's rib_top_z

rib_theta_deg.estimator: per rib: (r-5.7)-weighted mean azimuth of rib faces r>5.75, z 18-27.5 (stem frame) - per rib in the order [~0, ~90, ~180, ~-90 deg]
rib_theta_deg.frame: stem-group local frame (tilted line), theta CCW about +Z from datum +X
rib_theta_deg.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading of this dimension (or the thread/bore spec from the owner) -> re-run measure + rebuild

rib_width.estimator: per rib: tangential extent at r=5.85+-0.06, median over z 18.5-27 (1 mm steps) - per rib in the order [~0, ~90, ~180, ~-90 deg]
rib_width.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading of this dimension (or the thread/bore spec from the owner) -> re-run measure + rebuild
rib_width.note: rib tip modelled as a full round (R = width/2): fitted tip radius median 0.497 (rib_tip.json), mean width/2 0.532

rib_top_z.estimator: per rib: z where the crest radius (max r within +-2.5 deg, 0.05 mm steps) crosses the midpoint between the z=27 tip radius and the core radius at z=28 - per rib in the order [~0, ~90, ~180, ~-90 deg]

sleeve_bottom_z.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_top_z.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_bottom_ramp_start_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)
sleeve_bottom_ramp_start_deg.frame: spigot local frame (stem-group line), theta CCW about +Z from datum +X, 0..360; ramp rises with theta (right-hand)

sleeve_bottom_ramp_end_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)
sleeve_bottom_ramp_end_deg.frame: spigot local frame (stem-group line), theta CCW about +Z from datum +X, 0..360; ramp rises with theta (right-hand)

sleeve_bottom_ramp_h.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_top_ramp_start_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)
sleeve_top_ramp_start_deg.frame: spigot local frame (stem-group line), theta CCW about +Z from datum +X, 0..360; ramp rises with theta (right-hand)

sleeve_top_ramp_end_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)
sleeve_top_ramp_end_deg.frame: spigot local frame (stem-group line), theta CCW about +Z from datum +X, 0..360; ramp rises with theta (right-hand)

sleeve_top_ramp_h.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_crest_R.estimator: fit of touching-arc ripple r(z)=Rc-rho+sqrt(rho^2-dz^2), period p, to sleeve OD faces z 32.6-36.95, theta -95..120 (planar sector, stem frame)
sleeve_crest_R.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading of this dimension (or the thread/bore spec from the owner) -> re-run measure + rebuild

sleeve_ripple_pitch.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading of this dimension (or the thread/bore spec from the owner) -> re-run measure + rebuild

sleeve_first_crest_z.estimator: same fit: z of the first crest

sleeve_tail_r_in.estimator: p2 radius of scan faces above top_level+0.25 inside the top-ramp sector (inner edge of the helical tail)

bore_R.estimator: mean of bore station circle fits z 36.3, 36.8 (inward faces)
bore_R.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading of this dimension (or the thread/bore spec from the owner) -> re-run measure + rebuild

bore_shoulder_top_z.estimator: bore shoulder cone: line z=a+b r through +Z-facing shoulder faces r 2.8-4.05 (a=32.1011, b=0.9127), evaluated at r=bore_R

bore_floor_z.estimator: p0.5 z of scan faces inside the bore (deepest observed) - the model closes the bore with a flat floor here (floor shape assumed, see open_questions)

bore_floor_r.estimator: shoulder line (a,b above) evaluated at bore_floor_z; cf. innermost observed radius 3.072 (bore_seen_min_r)

simplifications.name: stem group axis
simplifications.modelled_as: stem revolve and spigot revolve each Z-parallel, centred on the fitted tilted line (tilt 0.754 deg) at their mid heights
simplifications.deviation_cost: <= 0.072 mm lateral over the stem core half-span (5.5 mm x tan tilt), <= 0.050 over the spigot half-span

simplifications.name: stem core roundness
simplifications.modelled_as: cone R(z) through station circle fits
simplifications.deviation_cost: station circle rms 0.072-0.087, p95 0.165 mm (axes.json stem_core_45)

simplifications.name: one mould draft
simplifications.modelled_as: draft_deg on cap wall, lever flanks, lever tip and blends
simplifications.deviation_cost: flanks +/-0.030 mm over 13.7 mm; lever tip cone read 2.16 deg -> <= 0.10 mm at z=0/13.7

simplifications.name: lever tip tangent to flanks
simplifications.modelled_as: tip arc tangent to both flank lines, centre on their bisector at x=lever_tip_cx
simplifications.deviation_cost: fitted tip circle R(z=0) 4.588 centre y 0.118 vs tangent arc: <= 0.22 mm at z=0 on +Y, ~0.06 mm at mid height

simplifications.name: single crown round
simplifications.modelled_as: one fillet R=crown_round_R on the whole crown loop
simplifications.deviation_cost: reads 2.436 (cap, rms 0.038) / 2.482 (lever tip, rms 0.114, not circular): <= 0.1 mm

simplifications.name: single step-edge round
simplifications.modelled_as: one fillet R=step_edge_R on the step-face outer loop

simplifications.name: pocket single draft, flat floor, no floor fillet, no mouth round
simplifications.modelled_as: one draft pocket_draft_deg, flat floor at pocket_floor_z
simplifications.deviation_cost: wall drafts 3.0/5.6/3.4 deg -> <= 0.14 mm at the floor; floor seen by only 64 faces; mouth round ~0.3 not modelled -> <= 0.09 mm

simplifications.name: sleeve ripple as rings
simplifications.modelled_as: 4 touching crest arcs (tori) at fixed z; helical crossover only on the end faces
simplifications.deviation_cost: inside the ramp sectors (about 120 deg) the scanned crests rise with the crossover; ring ripple is misplaced there by at most the ripple depth 0.181 mm

simplifications.name: sleeve end ramps
simplifications.modelled_as: level + linear right-hand helical ramp + step (bottom cut tool, top tail)

simplifications.name: groove depths
simplifications.modelled_as: one arc per groove (median over sectors)
simplifications.deviation_cost: outer groove bottom spread 0.60 mm, inner 0.44 mm across sectors -> up to ~0.3 mm locally

simplifications.name: rib ends and roots
simplifications.modelled_as: flat rib top at rib_top_z (mid-crossing), no root fillets, full-round tips
simplifications.deviation_cost: crest falls from tip to core over ~0.5 mm in z -> <= 0.25 mm at the rib tops; root fillets <= 0.1 mm

simplifications.name: bore notch (E20) not modelled
simplifications.deviation_cost: notch ~0.5 mm deep, ~25 deg wide at theta ~180, z 36-37 (bore r(theta) max 4.59 vs 4.09)

simplifications.name: sleeve top inner lip not modelled
simplifications.deviation_cost: lip r 4.2-4.4 stands ~0.1 mm above the top face

simplifications.name: stem base flare
simplifications.modelled_as: straight line from the inner groove's innermost point to the core at stem_base_z

simplifications.name: interior

simplifications.deviation_cost: not observable by the scan; CAD->scan on hidden interior not evaluated
